content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London's O2 arena ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and a lorry, prompting the London fire brigade to respond to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday; the blaze was brought under control after just over an hour with the help of 25 firefighters and no injuries were reported. The incident followed a pre‑planned filming activity at the site close to the venue that will host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas next week, and the brigade posted on X confirming the fire was under control, noting that one vehicle was lost while most of a car and a lorry suffered damage, with no casualties. It added that the fire originated from a controlled explosion on the set that spread beyond expectations, and crews remained on scene for the rest of the evening. The yard is also situated near London’s Thames cable car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesperson said they were aware of reports of explosions heard in the vicinity of the O2 in Greenwich.
